hooks.name: Run Tests on Service File Save
hooks.description: Automatically runs the incident-service and production-modules test suites whenever a service JS file is saved, giving immediate feedback on regressions without leaving the editor.

action.command: cd /d "C:\Project\ResQGrid-Smart-Emergency-Coordinator" && node --require ./test-globals-preload.cjs test-incident-service.mjs 2>nul | findstr /C:"Passed:" /C:"Failed:" /C:"✓ All" /C:"✗" && node --require ./test-globals-preload.cjs test-production-modules.mjs 2>nul | findstr /C:"Passed:" /C:"Failed:" /C:"✓ All" /C:"✗"
